title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
administering_authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
summary: PM-KISAN provides income support of ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families across India, payable in three equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts through DBT.

benefits.description: Direct financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each directly into the bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
conditions: Must have cultivable landholding in the family name
Must complete mandatory Aadhaar e-KYC on the PM-KISAN portal
Not falling under any institutional or high-income exclusion criteria

rules.explanation: Applicant family must possess cultivable landholding in their names.
Exclusion: All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year are ineligible.
Exclusion: Institutional landholders are not eligible.
Exclusion: Serving or retired officers and employees of central/state government departments, PSEs, and autonomous institutions (excluding MTS/Class IV staff) are ineligible.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.condition: Mandatory for beneficiary identity verification and DBT linking

required_documents.name: Landholding Ownership Records (Khasra/Khatauni/RoR)
required_documents.condition: Proof of ownership of cultivable agricultural land

required_documents.name: Bank Account Passbook / Statement
required_documents.condition: Active savings account linked with Aadhaar and mobile number

application_steps.description: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (https://pmkisan.gov.in) or visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Select 'New Farmer Registration' and choose Rural Farmer or Urban Farmer registration.
Enter Aadhaar Number and registered mobile number, then submit the received OTP for UIDAI authentication.
Fill in land details (Survey/Khata/Khasra numbers, land area, registration ID) and upload supporting documents.
Submit self-declaration regarding eligibility exclusions and finalize submission for State Nodal Officer verification.
